services.name: Shell Island Snorkel Cruise on the "Island Time" Catamaran
services.desc: The “Shell Island Snorkel & Dolphin Cruise” is approximately 3 hours of fun in the sun! 3 Hours About First you'll cruise to the beautiful St. Andrews Bay where we will find the day’s best spot based on conditions and clarity. The boat will anchor in approximately 5 feet of water where you can snorkel for seashells and catch a glimpse of the underwater world, learn about local sea-life, or just relax and float while you take in the sun. You can also wade through the shallow water onto Shell Island to hunt for shells or try out the stand-up paddleboards.
